protocol: Floe guest system DNS bridge v1
authority: Main frozen cross-language interface; changes require coordinated version change, not unilateral edits
transport: AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM, filesystem namespace, one request and one response per connection
bindContract: Runtime creates short private0700 per-work socket directory under its own filesDir, listens at s, binds that directory only at /run/floe-dns. Keep real host sun_path below108 bytes. No abstract socket, network port or model-controlled host path.
callerAuth: Runtime checks accepted LocalSocket.peerCredentials.uid == android.os.Process.myUid(); private filesystem directory also excludes other Android UIDs. Guest helper is same runtime UID. No provider/Core secret or unauthenticated network relay.

frame.request: magic + DNS message length + raw DNS message
frame.connection: exactly one transaction, then close; malformed/multiple/oversized frames refused

dnsPolicy: Android handler uses current active Network and public system resolver for each query. API>=29 DnsResolver.rawQuery flags0, separate cancellation/deadline. API28 needs system Network.getAllByName for A/AAAA rather than raw plaintext fallback. Offline returns bounded failure while local commands work; ongoing owned queries follow actual system network/PrivateDNS changes. No public/raw/base-image resolver fallback.

guestAbi.glibcFloor: 2.28 or lower-compatible floor supported by pinned existing toolchain; actual rootfs Debian bookworm2.36
guestAbi.nsswitchHosts: files floe; no dns tail fallback
guestAbi.scope: normal getaddrinfo-backed Python/Node HTTP/npm/apt traffic. Direct Node c-ares/dnspython/raw DNS sockets do not become NSS users; document that limitation precisely instead of claiming universal interception.

assetContract.location: signed runtime APK assets; Main copies verified producer output into runtimeapp/src/main/assets/guest-resolver at final integration. Kotlin owner stages immutable-asset bytes safely, verifies SHA/source-manifest bounds and binds helper into guest. Source/manifest missing never becomes ready.

sources.path: safe module-relative source file path, sorted UTF8

assetContract.manifestRules: Deterministic JSON; no volatile timestamps/private host paths. Source list bounded<=64, each path<=256 bytes/no absolute or traversal, manifest<=65536 bytes. sourceTreeSha256 = SHA256 of sorted UTF8 lines "<sha256>  <path>\n" for public module inputs (exclude generated outputs). Runtime verifies schema/protocol/library/target/soname/size/sha+matching sidecar; source file hashes/protocol bindings are final producer+CCS validation, not model flags.

ownership: Guest-helper worker owns only this module+its producer/CCS support. Facilities owner owns Android handler/verification/install/lifecycle/NSS bind+power; no shared writes. Main owns actual final C/native/APK builds and signed assets. No dependent jobs queued.
noClaims: Source contract only; no compiled helper or working App/device proof yet.
